name: ProteinMPNN
summary: Backbone-conditioned protein sequence design using pretrained neural-network weights.

steps: Clone the maintainer repository at a reviewed commit into a user-chosen directory and create a separate Python environment.
Install the PyTorch and NumPy versions appropriate for the selected CPU or GPU, following the maintainer README and the PyTorch compatibility guidance.
Inspect the included weight files and choose the full-backbone or CA-only model deliberately; do not fetch or replace weights silently.
install.verify_note: In the repository and isolated environment, run python protein_mpnn_run.py --help, then a maintainer example only if the user approves the computation.

notes: Sequence design is not structure prediction. A model run requires an input protein backbone and selected weights.
